compiled_state.title: [test-merge-to-main-pr]: git log origin/main in CI -> merge commit SHA not found
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
t_pr_poll_succeeds_on_merged_state_exit_zero fails in CI with: ERROR: PR reported merged but merge commit SHA not found on origin/main.
The git fetch origin main via git shim's exec delegation does not appear to populate refs/remotes/origin/main in the CI environment, even though a pre-fetch was added to the fixture setup.
Test passes locally (macOS/bash) but fails on every CI run (Ubuntu/bash).

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 4 (INTERMEDIATE) — CI-only failure in git fixture; SHA not found after fetch via shim exec delegation
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 4 (INTERMEDIATE). ROOT_CAUSE: polling fixture gh shim reads merge SHA from file at runtime (tr runtime path) vs success fixture which bakes SHA into shim heredoc at write time. Only material diff between the failing fixture and the passing sister test. Fix: bake merge_sha variable into polling shim at heredoc-write time, matching success fixture pattern.
comments.author: Test
